Page 9
Nov. 10 Virginia Caniso - 22 - very threatening case of confinement - Dr. seems to have very Boys in Service .... Thanksgiving Day ...
Nov. 24 Mrs. Esther Hogan - 33 - peculiar spinal trouble - Dr's at sea at to just what the trouble is. .. though very painful and mysterious. Enrolled To-day ... 5.00.
Mrs. Rose McMahan - 46 - lost her one breast last Sept. 16th. Op- eration Okay; healed well. Now however, she has fearful pains in eye and side of face. . . . .
Paul Topolsky - 37 - peculiar groth in vocal cords; operated on - removed - last February and on All Souls Day - Dr's in Harper under- took to remove it again when patient colapsed - now can only whisper - has wife and three small children. Enrolled 5. "Missing in Action" Robert Doyle
James Pungugast - losing faith.
Page 10 Nov. 25 John Roney - 7 - diptheria
26 Mrs. Marie Plunkett - 55 - peculiar weakness and severe pain in back. Agnes Moran - 53 - very nervous.
